author: Play On Tabletop
description:
We play the new Armageddon Box and the latest edition of Warhammer 40,000. Episode sponsored by https://themagnetbaron.com/ They have an "attractive" offering of magnets and more for your hobby needs!

Space Marines from the Blood Angel's Chapter and Orks kick off the new 11th Edition of Warhammer 40,000. Play On Tabletop received an early access copy from Games Workshop. Aiden and Jordan play the forces from the box that were gorgeously painted by Mitchell, Tycho, and Adam.
